import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    a, b, c = map(int, input.split())
    
    # Ensure a <= b <= c
    if a > b: a, b = b, a
    if a > c: a, c = c, a
    if b > c: b, c = c, b
    
    # Check if it's possible to make all pixels the same color
    if c > a + b + 1:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(a + b)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
